description: Workflows that run third-party code referenced by branch. deploy.yml hands the production SSH private key to two actions pinned to `@master`; ci.yml calls a shared reusable workflow at `@main` with `secrets: inherit` and runs CodeQL's init/analyze sub-actions at `@main`. Whoever can push to those branches — or compromise the maintainer — runs code with those secrets on the next run. VC121 must fire on each.
